A.label: The question
A.headline: Who are you when no one's watching?
A.body: Twelve apps track your steps, your sleep, your money. None of them ask how you're really doing. AquariOS measures your vitality across 4 dimensions — body, mind, meaning, and connection — and shows you where to act.
A.cta: Come back to you → free pre-registration

B.label: The number
B.headline: You have a vitality score.
B.body: iVi: one single number, in real time, integrating physical, mental, spiritual, and social. No scattered charts, no noise — plus a journal not even our AI can read.
B.cta: Discover your iVi → free, no card

C.label: The origin
C.headline: Born from a near heart attack. Became a fresh start.
C.body: A dentist, 36 years in practice, and the question that changed everything: "Where did I lose myself?" The answer became the first Personal Operating System for whole-person health.
